news.title: XiDeLang FY2026 Net Loss Widens to RMB135.2m on 18-Month Basis

recent_en: XDL released its annual audited accounts for the year ended 30 June 2026 and its annual report on 30 October 2026. It had earlier announced consolidated results for the financial period ended 30 June 2026 on 1 September and 28 August. News reported that FY2026 net loss widened to RMB135.2 million on an 18-month basis.

Announced consolidated results for the financial period ended 30 June 2026
